seo.pirateDescription: The Career Development Centre at NO Anchor University: a word to recruiters, the first placement drive of 1717, and who to contact. A hackathon parody of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

original.title: Career Development Centre
original.lede: The University has a long record of preparing graduates for employment in industry, government and research.

pirate.title: Hired Hands
pirate.lede: Where the crew meets the companies that want to hire them. Recruiters welcome. Parrots by appointment.

facts.label: Our first recruiter: a merchant ship short of a cook

original.heading: Director’s Message
paragraphs: Our graduates have joined ships, mines, laboratories and boardrooms since 1717. They know how to work in a crew, how to solve a problem with whatever is on board, and how to stay calm when the map is wrong. We would be delighted to introduce them to you.
original.name: Gold D. Roger

pirate.heading: A word from the Captain
pirate.kicker: Read out word for word. Nobody edits the Captain.

original.heading: Chairperson, (CDC)’s Message
paragraphs: The Career Development Centre welcomes recruiters for internships and full-time positions throughout the year. Our students are trained across seventeen departments and are ready to contribute from their first day. Please contact the Centre to arrange a campus visit; we will do our best to be in the same place when you arrive.
original.name: Gold D. Roger

paragraphs: The University’s first recruiter, a merchant vessel in need of a cook, visited the campus in its founding year. Placement activity has continued without interruption since.

pirate.heading: The first placement drive, 1717
paragraphs: In 1717 a merchant ship pulled alongside, short of a cook. Three students volunteered, and one of them stayed on as head chef. The Career Development Centre has been running ever since.

aside.label: Placement tip
aside.text: Today there is an online portal. It is much quicker than waiting for a ship.
